_doc: Firing smoke of tank guns, the PaK 40 and the Flak 18 (Fx::muzzle) and the launcher backblast (Fx::backblast). Read once at start-up by fx.cpp (docs/settings.md#firing-smoke). Sizes scale with the gun's muzzleScale (vehicle JSON gun.muzzleScale, station muzzleScale). Alpha fades as (life left)^fadePow after a quick fade-in. Before 2026-11 the discharge left 20 puffs at alpha 0.5-0.55 living 3-5 s.
